input: Sync all contacts from old phone to new

gold.taskTitle: Sync All Contacts From Old Phone to New
gold.taskDescription: Transfer all contacts stored on the user's old phone over to their new phone completely and correctly.

questions.title: What is the make and model of your old phone?
questions.description: Identifies the source device to determine available transfer methods.

questions.title: What is the make and model of your new phone?
questions.description: Identifies the destination device to match compatible transfer options.

questions.title: Are both phones the same operating system, like Android to Android?
questions.description: Determines whether the transfer is same-OS or cross-platform, which affects the method.

questions.title: Where are the contacts currently stored on the old phone?
questions.description: Clarifies whether contacts live on the SIM card, device storage, Google, iCloud, or another account.

questions.title: Do you still have physical access to the old phone?
questions.description: Determines whether direct transfer methods are possible or if a backup must be used instead.

questions.title: Have you already set up an account on the new phone?
questions.description: Checks whether a Google, Apple, or other account is active on the new device for cloud syncing.

questions.title: Are there any duplicate contacts you want cleaned up during the transfer?
questions.description: Establishes whether the user wants a clean, deduplicated contact list or a straight copy.
